XenotypeDef.label: trog
XenotypeDef.description: Trogs are the lurching result of generations of interbreeding between neanderthals, wasters, and dirtmoles on the worst rimworlds humanity ever forgot. That ancestry still produces surprises: about half develop unexpected extra genes. Despite their slowness and stench, they are capable settlers, with a knack for mining and handling animals. Wild insects leave them alone, and pollution invigorates them, though even the gas they release to repel enemies can poison them too.\n\nTrog tribes raise families amid toxic sludge and underground rot, making their homes in derelict mines and along the margins of insect hives. Other xenohumans regard them with disgust and distrust, and their belligerent tribes do little to improve that reputation. They refuse peaceful dealings with outsiders, and neighboring settlements know them chiefly as raiders. No one is quite sure how they survive in the places they inhabit, but they do, much to everyone else's dismay.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Trogs are foul-smelling but capable settlers, skilled at mining and handling animals. About half develop random extra genes. Wild insects leave them alone, and pollution invigorates them, though their own defensive gas can still poison them.
